# runpod_registries (Data Source)

All container registry credentials owned by the authenticated account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_registries" "all" {}

output "registry_ids" {
  description = "Credential identifiers, referenced from private-image pods and endpoints."
  value       = { for r in data.runpod_registries.all.registries : r.name => r.id }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `registries` (Attributes List) One entry per registry credential. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))

<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Credential identifier; reference it from a pod or endpoint registry attribute.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `username` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated. Always null: REST v2 treats a credential's username as write-only and no other supported API reports it.
